subclaims.claim: Physical sensor, clock and actuator implementation remains outside controller production code.
subclaims.evidence: Declarations in include/hw_interface.h:17-36; production calls in src/detect_obstacle.c:10-12, src/detect_dust.c:8, src/issue_movement_output.c:17 and src/put_outputs.c:10; CMakeLists.txt:31-42 packages production without a hardware executable.

subclaims.claim: Fake and simulator adapters are separate implementations of the abstract boundary rather than physical drivers.
subclaims.evidence: tests/fake_hw.cpp:24-66 supplies fields/records commands; simulator/host/sim_host.c:85-135 supplies stdin readings and stores enums; CMakeLists.txt:57-59,97-102 selects adapter per executable.

paths_walked: main -> wait_for_tick -> controller -> get_inputs -> detect_obstacle/detect_dust -> read_*
controller -> put_outputs -> issue_movement_output -> drive_motor; put_outputs -> drive_cleaner
Fake reset and Tick callback/termination; simulator Tick EOF/malformed-input/normal branches and command resets
CMake production static/object libraries, test executable and simulator executable adapter selection

searched.result: Enumerated production, interfaces, tests, simulator and SA files.
Boundary declarations/calls found; boundary implementations only fake/host; no listed device primitive or receive_input_event hit.

searched.scope: requirements, SA context/data dictionary/PSPEC, SD structure/transform, CMakeLists.txt
searched.result: B6 explicitly excludes hardware implementation; SD separately requires ordered software input delivery.

limitations: B6 scope verdict does not certify ordered-event SD/C12/C15 conformance or C13 initialization behavior. Hardware outside the repository is excluded and untested.
